title: JAMS — Personal AI Operating System
shortDescription: A local, persistent Personal AI Operating System designed as an intelligent manager coordinating specialized AI workers via the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
description: JAMS is a local, persistent Personal AI Operating System designed to act as an intelligent manager rather than another chatbot or coding assistant. It coordinates specialized workers while maintaining long-term context, memory, planning, task state, and decisions.

caseStudy.problem: Modern AI tools operate mostly as isolated, stateless chat sessions or narrow assistants lacking persistent memory, project-wide context, and the ability to coordinate multi-worker workflows autonomously.
caseStudy.solution: Designed a manager-worker operating system where JAMS maintains high-level context, memory, task planning, and state, delegating execution to specialized workers (starting with Zoo Code) through an MCP communication layer.
features: Model Context Protocol (MCP) communication layer for task delegation
Canonical startup configuration & structured workspace (Core, Memory, Tasks, Logs)
Persistent context & memory across projects, tasks, and user preferences
Task lifecycle management (creation, assignment, progress tracking & completion)
Zoo Code specialized coding worker integration
caseStudy.challenges: Designing a robust MCP-based contract between the manager and independent worker processes while preserving persistent memory and deterministic task states across sessions.
caseStudy.outcome: Foundation phase complete with canonical workspace structure (AGENTS.md, SOUL.md, IDENTITY.md, USER.md) and task template generation. Currently advancing the MCP Communication Layer.
caseStudy.learnings: Agentic AI architectures, hierarchical orchestration protocols, and file-based state management for persistent local intelligence.
